generated_by: read-only audit of Supabase qxfrypvevjsyzkquewxh + legacy CSV corpus

status_legend.legacy: Observed as a column with real values in the legacy CSV corpus. Not yet registered.
status_legend.proposed: Named in the founder brief. NO supporting data found. Do not activate without a capture protocol.
status_legend.needs_review: Observed, but it is a DERIVED value or its semantics are unsafe. Must not be loaded as a raw observation.

conventions.raw_or_derived: raw = a direct measurement or a coach's direct observation. derived = computed from other values.
conventions.higher_is_better: Stated explicitly on every metric. The corpus contains metrics whose NAME implies the opposite of the truth.
conventions.benchmark_required: true where a 0-100 normalisation needs a population reference before the score means anything.
conventions.unit_null: null unit means the metric is categorical or ordinal, not measured in a physical unit.

metrics.name: speed_10m_sprint_s
metrics.protocol: Standing start, 10m gate. Surface and footwear must be recorded — an inline 10m and an ice 10m are not comparable.
metrics.description: Time to cover 10m from a standing start.
metrics.notes: Registered for football only. BIIF 2026 sheets capture a comparable 'Raw Time(10m dash)' on skates — see LEGACY_RAW_TIME_10M_DASH. Do NOT merge the two without a surface-aware benchmark.

metrics.name: speed_30m_sprint_s
metrics.protocol: Standing start, 30m gate, split recorded at 10m where available.
metrics.description: Time to cover 30m from a standing start.

metrics.name: power_cmj_cm
metrics.protocol: Hands on hips, countermovement permitted, best of 3.
metrics.description: Vertical jump height from a countermovement.

metrics.name: stamina_yyir1_m
metrics.protocol: Yo-Yo Intermittent Recovery Test Level 1, standard audio protocol.
metrics.description: Total distance covered before failure.

metrics.name: phy_match_minutes
metrics.protocol: Recorded by match official or coach.
metrics.description: Minutes played in a fixture. Exposure, not performance.
metrics.notes: higher_is_better is null on purpose: more minutes is exposure, not merit. Used as a denominator.

metrics.name: phy_gps_session_load_au
metrics.protocol: Vendor GPS unit. Vendor and firmware must be recorded — arbitrary units are not comparable across vendors.
metrics.description: Vendor-computed session load in arbitrary units.
metrics.notes: Derived by the vendor, not by Athlytica. Store the vendor and firmware version alongside or the number is meaningless.

metrics.name: phy_distance_total_m
metrics.protocol: GPS unit, full session.
metrics.description: Total distance covered in a session or fixture.

metrics.name: phy_hsr_distance_m
metrics.protocol: Distance above a speed threshold. THE THRESHOLD MUST BE RECORDED — it varies by provider and age group.
metrics.description: Distance covered above the high-speed-running threshold.

metrics.name: tac_match_rating
metrics.protocol: Single coach judgement post-fixture. Subjective by design; attribute to the coach.
metrics.description: Coach's tactical rating for a fixture.
metrics.notes: A coach assessment, not a measurement. Never overwrite; a new rating is a new observation.

metrics.name: tac_position_secondary
metrics.protocol: Coach-declared.
metrics.description: Secondary playing position.
metrics.notes: Profile attribute, not a metric. Candidate for relocation to athlete_discipline.role_position.

metrics.name: veo_clip_tag
metrics.protocol: Veo platform clip reference.
metrics.description: Reference to a verified video clip.
metrics.notes: This is VERIFICATION EVIDENCE, not a performance metric. Belongs in the trust layer (verification_event.evidence_uri), not the metric registry.

metrics.name: acad_igcse_subject_grade
metrics.protocol: Official school transcript.
metrics.description: IGCSE grade for one subject.
metrics.notes: Academic record for recruitment eligibility. Sensitive minor data — must be access-gated separately from athletic metrics.

metrics.name: acad_igcse_term_average
metrics.protocol: School-reported term average.
metrics.description: Average across subjects for a term.

metrics.name: acad_eligibility_status
metrics.protocol: Derived from academic record against a programme's entry requirements.
metrics.description: Whether the athlete meets academic eligibility for recruitment.

metrics.name: session_rpe
metrics.protocol: Coach-assigned post-session. Source values are labelled strings, e.g. '5 (Moderate)', '7 (High / Vigorous)'. Parse the leading integer; retain the label.
metrics.description: Perceived intensity of a training session.
metrics.notes: Present across all 7 years. Coach-assigned rather than athlete-reported, which is a deviation from standard sRPE — record whose perception it is.

metrics.name: session_duration_min
metrics.protocol: Scheduled session length.
metrics.description: Length of the training session in minutes.
metrics.notes: Scrimmage Tracker stores duration with the unit inline ('50 min' vs '50'). Strip on ingest; do not coerce silently.

metrics.name: session_load
metrics.protocol: Appears to be RPE x duration (300 = 5 x 60, 420 = 7 x 60 in 2020 rows). UNVERIFIED across the full corpus.
metrics.description: Training load for a session.
metrics.notes: DERIVED, and BROKEN IN 2022: the value is '#REF!' for 100% of 2022 rows (984 occurrences corpus-wide). Recompute from RPE x duration rather than importing the stored value.

metrics.name: coach_grade
metrics.protocol: Coach judgement per session. Source values are labelled, e.g. '3 (Acceptable: Met most goals)', '4(Strong: Exceeded expectations)'.
metrics.description: Overall coach grade for the athlete's session.
metrics.notes: Scale labels are embedded in the 2026 header, misspelled ('Devoloping'). Spacing varies ('3 (' vs '4('). Attribute to the coach; never overwrite.

metrics.name: work_rate
metrics.protocol: Coach judgement. Source values are long labelled strings, e.g. '5; Did the work but required constant prompting', '10; Lead the pack, high intensity, zero complains, set to finish drill'.
metrics.description: Effort and engagement during the session.
metrics.notes: Delimiter drifts between ';' and ':' across years. Observed values cluster at 5 and 10 — the intermediate scale may be unused in practice. Check before benchmarking.

metrics.name: technical_breaks_count
metrics.protocol: Coach tallies breaks in technique during a session. Definition of a 'break' is UNKNOWN and must be documented before benchmarking.
metrics.description: Count of technique breakdowns observed in a session.
metrics.notes: THIS IS THE RAW METRIC. Observed range 0-4. TECHNICAL_PRECISION is fully determined by it and carries no extra information. Migrate this; recompute that.

metrics.name: perfect_recovery
metrics.protocol: Coach selects one of five prose descriptors. The FULL descriptor string is the source value; parse the leading integer and retain the text.
metrics.description: Quality of balance recovery after a disturbance.
metrics.notes: A rubric-anchored ordinal, which is stronger than a bare number. The 'Perfect Recovery %' rollup in Athlete Progress is 0% for every athlete — do NOT migrate that rollup as measured zero.

metrics.name: full_extension_on_push
metrics.protocol: Coach selects one of five prose descriptors describing leg extension at the end of the push.
metrics.description: Completeness of leg extension through the skating push.
metrics.notes: 'Full Extension %' rollup is 0% for every athlete in Athlete Progress. Empty, not zero.

metrics.name: low_centre_of_gravity
metrics.protocol: Coach selects one of five prose descriptors describing knee bend and stance height.
metrics.description: Depth and stability of the skating stance.
metrics.source: LEGACY: 'Low Center of Gravity' (2020) / 'Low_Center_of\_Gravity' (2022, literal backslash) / 'Low Center of Gravity (Check)' (2026)
metrics.notes: Column name drifts three ways across years including a literal backslash. 'Low COG %' rollup is 0% for every athlete. Empty, not zero.

metrics.name: performance_score
metrics.protocol: Coach's overall score for the session's drill work.
metrics.description: Coach's 0-10 score for session performance.
metrics.notes: Absent from the 2026 sheet, which substitutes Speed score / Power Score / Technical precision. A schema break between 2025 and 2026.

metrics.name: determinant_drill_passed
metrics.protocol: Pass/fail on the session's determinant drill. The drill itself is free text in 'Determinant_Drill' and must be captured alongside.
metrics.description: Whether the athlete passed the session's gating drill.
metrics.notes: ENCODING DRIFT: 'TRUE'/'FALSE' in 2020, 'YES'/'NO' in 2022. A boolean is meaningless without the drill — 'Walk on grass' and 'Beginner stepovers' are not the same test.

metrics.name: attendance_status
metrics.protocol: Recorded per scheduled session. Paired with 'Scheduled_Status' (SCHEDULED / NOT SCHEDULED).
metrics.description: Whether the athlete attended a scheduled session.
metrics.notes: Must be read together with Scheduled_Status: an absence from an unscheduled session is not an absence. The brief's 'excused' state is NOT present in the source vocabulary.

metrics.name: legacy_raw_time_10m_dash
metrics.protocol: 10m dash on skates. Surface UNKNOWN per row. Timing method UNKNOWN (hand vs gate).
metrics.description: Timed 10m dash on skates, 2026 sheet only.
metrics.source: LEGACY: 'Raw Time(10m dash)' — RAW DATA INPUT 2026
metrics.notes: Column frequently contains the free text "Didn't manage to take the speed" instead of a number. That is CORRECT coach behaviour recorded in the wrong place — it must load into observation.not_recorded_reason, never as 0 or NULL-with-no-reason.

metrics.name: speed_score_2026
metrics.protocol: UNKNOWN. Source values are labelled ('6 (Average)', '8 (Great)'). Relationship to Raw Time(10m dash) is UNVERIFIED.
metrics.description: Banded speed score in the 2026 sheet.
metrics.notes: Appears in rows where Raw Time is the free text "Didn't manage to take the speed" — so it is NOT purely a function of the timed dash. Derivation UNKNOWN. Do not treat as a measurement.

metrics.name: power_score_2026
metrics.protocol: UNKNOWN.
metrics.description: Computed power score in the 2026 sheet.
metrics.notes: Values carry full float precision (4.333333333, 5.333333333, 3) which is the signature of a spreadsheet formula, not a measurement. The inputs are UNKNOWN. Do not migrate as raw.

metrics.name: nrhl_games_played
metrics.protocol: Count of scrimmages in which the athlete appeared on a roster.
metrics.description: Scrimmage appearances.
metrics.source: LEGACY: Scrimmage Tracker cumulative block; athlete_individual_stats.csv 'games_played'
metrics.notes: Denominator for every per-game rate. Derive from fixture_participation rather than importing the rollup.

metrics.name: nrhl_assisted_goals
metrics.protocol: Goal scored from a team-mate's pass. Worth 3 points under NRHL-PTS-v1 to reward unselfish play.
metrics.description: Goals scored following an assist.
metrics.source: LEGACY: Scrimmage Tracker header labels 'Assisted Goals' / 'Unassisted Goals'; DB column nrhl_stat_line.assisted_goals
metrics.notes: CRITICAL GAP: athlete_individual_stats.csv collapsed assisted+unassisted into one 'goals' column, destroying the split that NRHL-PTS-v1 requires. The split is recoverable by algebra from (goals, assists, points) for all 31 athletes, and is present upstream in Scrimmage Tracker. RECOVER FROM SOURCE — do not rely on the extract.

metrics.name: nrhl_unassisted_goals
metrics.protocol: Goal scored without an assist. Worth 1 point under NRHL-PTS-v1.
metrics.description: Solo goals.
metrics.source: LEGACY: Scrimmage Tracker; DB column nrhl_stat_line.solo_goals
metrics.notes: Same collapse problem as NRHL_ASSISTED_GOALS. Note the DB calls it 'solo_goals' while the source calls it 'Unassisted Goals' — same concept, two names.

metrics.name: nrhl_assists
metrics.protocol: Pass directly leading to a goal. Worth 1 point under NRHL-PTS-v1.
metrics.description: Assists.

metrics.name: nrhl_attendance_rate_pct
metrics.protocol: Sessions attended / sessions scheduled.
metrics.description: Attendance percentage over the season.
metrics.notes: Derived rollup. Recompute from attendance observations; do not import. The window over which it was computed is UNKNOWN, and 3 Ice Hockey athletes have it blank entirely.

metrics.name: nrhl_penalty_minutes
metrics.protocol: Minutes assessed in penalties.
metrics.description: Penalty minutes.
metrics.notes: The column exists and is EMPTY for all 31 athletes. Do not migrate as zero. Either penalties were never tracked or the export dropped them — UNKNOWN which.

metrics.name: technical_precision
metrics.derivation_evidence: Verified on 265 of 265 rows in RAW DATA INPUT 2026 with zero mismatches. Observed pairs (breaks, precision): (0,4) (1,2) (2,0) (3,-2) (4,-4).
metrics.protocol: Not measured. Computed.
metrics.description: A linear restatement of the technical break count.
metrics.notes: MUST NOT BE STORED AS A RAW OBSERVATION. It carries zero information beyond TECHNICAL_BREAKS_COUNT. Store the break count; recompute this in the derived layer if it is wanted at all.

metrics.name: nrhl_total_points
metrics.derivation_evidence: Solved independently from athlete_individual_stats.csv for all 31 athletes with integer in-range splits, then confirmed against NRHL_POINT_FORMULA = { assisted: 3, solo: 1, assist: 1 } in lib/services/nrhl-etl.ts. Intent stated in Group sessions.csv Week 1: 'Unselfish play (3pts for assist goals)'.
metrics.protocol: Not measured. Computed from the stat line.
metrics.description: NRHL points, weighted to reward assisted goals over solo goals.
metrics.notes: THIS IS NOT THE STANDARD HOCKEY POINTS STAT. Noel Inoue: goals+assists = 58, NRHL points = 124. Any dashboard that recomputes points conventionally will halve every athlete. Always display alongside its scoring_version.

metrics.name: nrhl_speed_rating
metrics.derivation: Per-athlete mean of the per-session Speed score. Window UNKNOWN.
metrics.protocol: Not measured. Aggregated.
metrics.description: Season mean of the banded speed score.
metrics.notes: A mean of SPEED_SCORE_2026, which is itself derived by an UNKNOWN rule. Two derivation layers deep with no recorded provenance. Blank for the 3 Ice Hockey athletes.

metrics.name: nrhl_technical_rating
metrics.derivation: Per-athlete mean of TECHNICAL_PRECISION, which is itself 4 - 2*TECHNICAL_BREAKS_COUNT.
metrics.protocol: Not measured. Aggregated from a derived value.
metrics.description: Season mean of technical precision.
metrics.source: LEGACY: athlete_individual_stats.csv 'technical_rating'; 'Avg Tech Precision' in Athlete Progress.csv; DB column nrhl_athlete.technical_rating
metrics.notes: DANGEROUS. The name says 'rating' (implying higher is better) but the observed data inverts it: the strongest athletes hold the MOST NEGATIVE values (Noel Inoue -1.667, Dakota Weening -2.0) while the weakest holds the most positive (Leroy Sila +2.4, with 40% attendance and speed 1.6). Sorting DESC ranks the worst athletes first. Additionally the two rollups disagree on rounding (Raimi -0.387 vs -0.3), so the aggregation windows differ. DO NOT MIGRATE. Recompute from TECHNICAL_BREAKS_COUNT with an explicit, named direction.

metrics.description: Time to weave a cone set under puck control.

metrics.name: hockey_shooting_accuracy_pct

metrics.description: Velocity of a shot.

metrics.name: figure_spin_rotations

metrics.description: Rotations completed in a spin.
metrics.notes: 340 Figure Skating session rows exist in the corpus, but none carry spin, jump or glide metrics — only the generic skating rubric. Figure skating is currently measured with inline-skating instruments.

metrics.name: cognitive_decision_speed
metrics.protocol: PROPOSED. Rubric-anchored coach rating, following the 5-level prose pattern already used for the technical-compliance metrics.
metrics.description: Speed and quality of in-play decisions.
metrics.source: Founder brief §6D. 'Decision Speed' appears as a Week-1 focus area in Group sessions.csv, but is never measured.
metrics.notes: The curriculum names it as a training target; no capture instrument exists. Reuse the 5-level rubric pattern rather than inventing a bare 1-10 scale.
